tests: the credentials gate CLI delivers a report larger than one pipe buffer intact through a pipe

consumesExternalOutput.program: node src/gates/credentials.ts (the gate CLI under test), which itself spawns git and gh and reads their exit codes
consumesExternalOutput.provenance: The behaviour under test is what the gate CLI itself prints, and rule (f) binds this witness because the mutated file spawns another program and parses what it prints. The cited capture is REAL output of these three gate CLIs taken 2026-09-17 on node v26.6.0 in the kernel container, with the commands and the before/after byte counts recorded beside each block, and the named test reproduces its own recorded block live in a scratch fixture before asserting anything about a report that exceeds a stdio buffer. Nothing in the assertions is a hand-written string chosen to match the implementation (CLAUDE.md red-witness rule, strong form; standing warning 10).
